# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source (`index_old.html`) is a single-screen canvas cooking service arcade game. A queue of customers asks for one of three foods. The player chooses among three bottom buttons. Correctly matching the front customer increments score by one and removes that customer. Serving the wrong item or letting the front customer's patience reach zero ends the run. The game uses a requestAnimationFrame loop, procedural canvas drawing, score HUD, warning HUD, start/restart screens, keyboard shortcuts, and optional audio.

## Protected mechanics
- Three discrete food choices: burger, pizza, salad.
- Front-of-queue matching only; no spatial collision mechanic.
- Score increases by exactly one on correct serve.
- Wrong choice triggers immediate game over.
- Front customer's patience drains over time and triggers game over at zero.
- Spawn cadence and difficulty ramp remain time-based.
- Start, game over, and restart state flow remain intact.
